decision._comment: Jev decision model (TypeSafe System One). Local: run Ollaya (default port 11435) or Ollama with a Jev-style model. Hosted TypeSafe: set endpoint to the API base URL, path to /v1/systemone and export TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

referee_fallback._comment: Text LLM used to judge actions only when the Jev decision model is unreachable.
